events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: San Diego County Coastal Areas; Orange County Coastal
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...For the Beach Hazards Statement, minor tidal overflow
expected due to the combination of high tides and elevated
surf. For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding
expected due to the combination of high tides and elevated
surf.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Beach Hazards Statement, through late tonight.
For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 5 AM Monday to 5 PM PDT
Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Minor coastal flooding and minor coastal erosion
expected during high tides. Additionally, elevated surf will
lead to strong rip currents.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Elevated surf of 3-5 feet expected. Local
sets to 7 feet possible on south-facing beaches. Morning high
tides are expected to peak between 6.7 and 7.0 feet through
Wednesday, peaking Tuesday morning. The listed tide predictions
have been corrected to reflect current trends in actual tide
observations.

events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Northwest Plateau; Hualapai Mountains; Northwest Deserts
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...A portion of northwest Arizona, including the following
areas, Hualapai Mountains, Northwest Deserts and Northwest Plateau.

* WHEN...From late tonight through Tuesday evening.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Low-water crossings may be flooded.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Showers and thunderstorms capable of producing flash flooding.
- Kingman, Colorado City, Valentine, Dolan Springs, Wikieup, Peach
Springs.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
